reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Sara Shelp
reviews.text: A family owned operation, Alex and Cara were professional from the first phone call. As we planned a large tree removal, old stump removal/grind, and some tricky trimming of branches hanging over our deck and house (all large, tall oaks), calls and texts were clear and prompt. From the walk through for the estimate to service day, Alex and his team were prompt to the minute. The quote was very competitive; we did not need an arborist (and the associated premium) for this job. Care was taken to avoid a structure, camellia trees, our fence, home and septic and they even managed to work around a small new magnolia that was right in the middle of the action (I’d forgotten to move it). The tree climber/bucket operator was efficient and clearly skilled. The team left our property clean and they smoothed out the tracks that were inevitable because of recent rain. Alex even provided some valuable tips to help me manage a wild grapevine that’s taking over a fence. We would definitely hire Hampton’s again!

reviews.author: Gus Brown
reviews.text: Hamptons Tree Service was GREAT to work with! They provided the best price from the quoted I got and were able to do the job quickly! The crew was professional, friendly, and very talented. They were able to extract a very difficult tree not damaging my fence or overhead power lines. I will most definitely be using Hamptons Tree Service again.

reviews.author: American Lumberjack
reviews.text: Best tree service around. Safety first, insured, does the job right. Clean second. He will make sure to make the yard as clean as possible. Cuts'em down, cleans'em up!

reviews.author: Dave Wachs
reviews.text: Alex and his crew did a great job taking down a large maple and my neighbor's gum ball tree on the same day. They showed up as scheduled and worked very efficiently and safely. Every step was professional. The elimination of the roots and clean-up was more than I expected when we discussed the work. The yard looked amazing. I felt like I got a great value for the money I spent! Thanks Hampton's Tree Service.

reviews.author: Sarah Simpson
reviews.text: EDIT *** 2024. Alex and his team cut down that large oak tree for me. Price was right & team was excellent. Highly recommend. I contacted this company about a large oak tree that I love but might need removal. Alex was on time, responsive and he was very honest with me. He let me know he felt the tree was in great condition and didn’t need removal. But gave me quotes on removal & just a trim so I had both options if I ever wanted to get rid of it. I appreciated him telling me the tree could stay and for that reason… I would use this tree service for any needs in the future. Most companies wouldn’t have been so honest about the integrity of the tree. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Zachary Larmore
reviews.text: Had a great experience!! Called and he was at my house within 10 minutes. Back within a week to complete the work and they were all incredibly compassionate when 3 baby northern striders were discovered in the tree. They all survived and were transported to the wildlife sanctuary.

reviews.author: J Hutch (OnemeanK9)
reviews.text: I can't recommend this company enough. I had 4 large pines removed and my neighbor had 6 removed and they were done in 3 days with both of our yards looking better than when they arrived. This is by far the best company that I have ever dealt with. Very professional. Very reasonably priced, and actually showed up and did the work quickly. If you are looking for someone to do tree service, don't hesitate calling these guys.

reviews.author: Liz Schimmel
reviews.text: Hampton Tree Service just finished our place on Bogue Sound two days ago ... around 6 trees. They did a fantastic job and in record time! They even brought in the chipper! Clean up was great too. Yesterday we had sustained winds of 17 mph with gusts to 27 mph and not one twig came out of those trees! These guys are fantastic!

reviews.author: Lindsey Steele
reviews.text: Contacted them, they were quick to come out and give us a quote - which was very reasonable. The work was done two weeks later in just two days. I got 9 pine trees removed, and they demolished and took out an old shed as well. They really tried hard not to cause too much damage to the surrounding grass and flattened the area where they removed trees. Very communicative and helpful. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Mike Immediato
reviews.text: Alex is an awesome business man. Very thorough on explaining the process and amount of time to complete the job. Reasonable rates for the amount of work involved. Raked the area outside of the job area to ensure no debris left behind. Loves what he does and appreciates his customers, and it shows!! Highly reccomend Hamptons Tree Service for all your tree cutting, removal, trimming, and stumpgrinding needs!

reviews.author: Frankie Dennis
reviews.text: Best reeds service in town. Honest, true, hardworking And down to earth. They will leave your yard better than they found it. And you'll never know the tree was there. They are commercial and residential. The pricing is fair and unbeatable. They are insured and will travel. Not to mention, free bids.

reviews.author: Patricia Stimpson
reviews.text: Excellent! Alex and his crew did an outstanding job! Hard working, diligent, affordable and did a great job cleaning up all of the debris. I highly recommend their services. Quincy & Patricia Stimpson.

reviews.author: Priscilla Duvall
reviews.text: Alex and his crew were on time, and did a fantastic job. They were quick to get here and fast with completing the job.They also had the best price out of four estimates! Would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: M Kelley
reviews.text: Everything you want from a contractor providing a service! Professional, courteous and knowledgeable crew! Reasonable price and schedule! Prompt and reliable! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kara Tadlock
reviews.text: Very responsive! The whole crew is very nice, professional, and hard working! They go way above and beyond what is expected of them, and are very reasonable! Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: John Davis
reviews.text: Did a great job removing some difficult trees. They were competitive in their charges and quick to the job. Very pleased!
